title: Wellcrest Health
description: Complete digital presence build — website, GMB profile, and local SEO — resulting in real walk-in traffic and steady sales growth.
overview: Wellcrest Health is a therapy and wellness clinic based in Lagos, offering physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and mental health counselling services. Despite having strong clinical expertise and a loyal word-of-mouth patient base, the clinic had zero digital footprint — no website, no Google presence, and no online booking capability. Walk-in traffic was nearly nonexistent, and new patient acquisition relied entirely on referrals. The clinic was losing potential patients to competitors who appeared in local search results and offered the convenience of online booking.
challenge: Wellcrest Health faced a complete absence of digital infrastructure. There was no website to showcase their services, credentials, or facilities. They had no Google My Business profile, making them invisible in local search results — the primary way patients now discover healthcare providers. Appointment booking was manual and phone-only, creating friction for potential patients. There was no patient intake system, no analytics to understand patient acquisition patterns, and no way to capture leads from organic search. The clinic needed a complete digital transformation from the ground up, but with a limited budget and no internal technical expertise.
solution: We designed and built a comprehensive digital ecosystem for Wellcrest Health. Starting with a fully responsive website featuring service pages with detailed descriptions of each therapy offering, practitioner profiles with credentials and specializations, an integrated appointment booking system with automated confirmation emails, and a patient resources section with educational content. We then established and optimized their Google My Business presence with accurate NAP data, professional photos of the facility, service categories, and a review management workflow. Finally, we implemented a targeted local SEO strategy including citation building across 30+ healthcare directories, location-specific content pages, and schema markup for medical businesses. We set up Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance and provided monthly reporting on key metrics.
testimonial: Intravent didn't just build us a website — they built our entire digital presence from scratch. For the first time, patients are finding us online, booking appointments without calling, and leaving reviews. The impact on our practice has been transformative.

title: KIPS Media Website
description: Boosted brand trust with content marketing and targeted ads, achieving 65% organic traffic growth and 75% revenue growth.
overview: KIPS Media is a global media and communications company with a strong reputation in broadcast and print. As they expanded into digital publishing, their existing website — built on an outdated CMS — was failing to keep pace. Page load times exceeded 8 seconds, mobile responsiveness was poor, and the content management workflow was cumbersome for the editorial team. Despite producing high-quality journalism, their articles ranked poorly on search engines, and their bounce rate was over 70%. Their digital advertising revenue was declining, and they needed a complete digital overhaul to remain competitive.
challenge: KIPS Media's legacy website suffered from multiple critical issues. Technical performance was abysmal — the site failed Google's Core Web Vitals assessment on all three metrics (LCP, FID, CLS). The information architecture was convoluted, with content buried under deep navigation paths that confused both users and search engine crawlers. There was no content strategy or editorial calendar; articles were published haphazardly without keyword research or SEO optimization. The mobile experience was broken, with overlapping elements and unreadable text on smaller screens. Their advertising placements were intrusive, further damaging user experience and increasing bounce rates. The editorial team was frustrated with the CMS, which required developer intervention for basic publishing tasks.
solution: We executed a comprehensive website transformation for KIPS Media. Starting with a complete platform migration to a modern, headless architecture using Next.js for blazing-fast performance. We redesigned the information architecture, creating clear content hierarchies, optimized navigation, and logical category structures that improved both UX and crawlability. We implemented a robust content strategy framework including keyword research for each content vertical, topic cluster modeling, and an editorial workflow that empowered the journalism team. On the technical side, we optimized every aspect of performance: image optimization with WebP and lazy loading, code splitting, CDN integration, and aggressive caching. We achieved a 95+ PageSpeed score across all devices. We also launched targeted PPC campaigns for high-value content categories to drive immediate traffic while organic SEO efforts gained traction.
testimonial: Our old website was holding us back. Intravent delivered a platform that not only looks world-class but performs exceptionally. Our editorial team loves the new CMS, our readers stay longer, and our bottom line has improved dramatically.

title: Agriktechnical & Allied Company
description: Increased sign-ups through engaging digital campaigns and targeted promotions, with 75% organic traffic growth and 88% revenue growth.
overview: Agriktechnical & Allied Company is a major agricultural supply distributor serving farms and agribusinesses across Nigeria. They supply fertilizers, seeds, farm equipment, and veterinary products to a network of over 500 registered farmers and agricultural enterprises. Despite having a solid B2B customer base, their online presence was virtually nonexistent. Their customer acquisition relied entirely on a sales team making cold calls and attending agricultural trade shows. They had no digital lead generation engine, no way to capture inbound inquiries, and their competitors were rapidly building online ordering platforms. They needed to digitize their customer acquisition funnel to survive in an increasingly digital agricultural marketplace.
challenge: Agriktechnical's challenges were multifaceted. Their brand awareness among modern, tech-savvy farmers was extremely low. The younger generation of agribusiness owners were searching online for suppliers, and Agriktechnical simply wasn't there. Their marketing efforts were ad-hoc — occasional radio jingles and flyers at trade shows with no measurable ROI. They had no customer database or CRM system; sales leads were tracked on spreadsheets and frequently lost. The sign-up process for new customers was entirely paper-based, requiring physical visits to their office. Their competitors had already launched WhatsApp ordering and basic websites, capturing the digital-savvy segment of the market. Agriktechnical needed not just a digital campaign, but a complete digital sales infrastructure.
solution: We designed and executed a comprehensive digital transformation of Agriktechnical's customer acquisition process. First, we built a multi-channel digital campaign strategy combining targeted social media advertising on Facebook and Instagram (where farmers increasingly spend time), Google Search Ads for high-intent agricultural queries, and email marketing campaigns to a curated list of industry contacts. We created compelling ad creative featuring real products and farmer testimonials. Second, we built a custom lead capture and CRM system using Django and PostgreSQL that automated the entire sales follow-up process — from initial inquiry to qualification to conversion. We integrated the CRM with their email and WhatsApp for seamless communication. Third, we optimized their Google My Business profile and built local landing pages for each region they served. Finally, we implemented Google Analytics and conversion tracking to measure every aspect of the funnel and enable data-driven optimization.
testimonial: Intravent showed us how to reach farmers where they actually are — online. The leads we're getting are better qualified, our sales team is more efficient, and the revenue growth has exceeded our expectations. This has been a game-changer for our business.

title: Philstone Consulting
description: Implemented a data-driven SEO and PPC strategy, boosting online visibility with 70% organic traffic growth and 75% revenue growth.
overview: Philstone Consulting is a boutique management consulting firm specializing in strategy, operations, and digital transformation for mid-market enterprises across West Africa. With a founding team of ex-McKinsey and BCG consultants, their expertise was world-class — but their digital presence was virtually invisible. Their website was a static brochure site built years ago, with no blog, no thought leadership content, and no SEO strategy. Potential clients searching for consulting services in Lagos and Accra were finding competitors instead. Despite winning every pitch they got, they simply weren't getting enough inbound opportunities. They needed to translate their offline reputation into online authority.
challenge: Philstone Consulting faced an uphill battle in digital visibility. Their website had numerous technical SEO issues: improper canonical tags, missing meta descriptions, duplicate content across pages, broken internal links, and no XML sitemap. The site loaded slowly due to unoptimized images and render-blocking resources. There was no structured data markup, meaning search engines couldn't properly understand their content. Content-wise, they had no blog or resource section — the primary channel for consulting firms to demonstrate thought leadership. Their competitors were publishing white papers, case studies, and industry reports, ranking for high-value keywords like "business strategy consulting Nigeria" and "digital transformation consultants Lagos." Philstone Consulting needed to build a complete content marketing engine from scratch while fixing deep technical issues and launching PPC campaigns for immediate visibility.
solution: We executed a three-phase digital strategy for Philstone Consulting. Phase 1 — Technical Foundation: We conducted a comprehensive technical SEO audit identifying 47 critical issues. We fixed canonicalization, implemented proper schema markup (Organization, LocalBusiness, Article, FAQ), rebuilt the sitemap architecture, optimized images with next-gen formats, and implemented server-side caching. We achieved a 92% diagnostic score on Sitebulb. Phase 2 — Content Engine: We built a sophisticated content hub on their website with category-specific blogs, downloadable white papers, case study templates, and an insights section. We developed a content strategy targeting 120+ keywords across management consulting, digital transformation, and operational excellence verticals. Phase 3 — Paid Acquisition: We launched Google Ads campaigns targeting high-intent keywords, with separate ad groups for each service line. We set up conversion tracking, call tracking, and lead scoring. Monthly performance reports with actionable recommendations ensured continuous improvement.
testimonial: Intravent brought a level of analytical rigor to our digital strategy that matched our own consulting methodology. They didn't just improve our rankings — they built a complete digital growth engine that continues to deliver results. Our pipeline has never been stronger.
